name: xflickr_latency_p95_high

query_condition.sql: SELECT approx_percentile_cont(latency_ms, 0.95) AS p95_ms FROM "xflickr_calls" WHERE latency_ms IS NOT NULL HAVING p95_ms > 8000

description: Impact: Flickr call p95 latency is above 8 seconds. Action: Inspect slow methods and upstream/network health.
